notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Daring Archaeologist and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Daring Archaeologist from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Daring Archaeologist enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Daring Archaeologist trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
